name: memory.remember
description: Store a durable user fact, preference, goal, or bookmark into persistent memory

params.name: content
params.description: Fact or memory content to record

params.name: category
params.description: Memory category: fact, preference, goal, or bookmark

name: memory.list
description: List all remembered items with category filters

params.name: category
params.description: Optional category filter (e.g. fact, preference, goal, bookmark)

name: memory.forget
description: Delete a remembered item by its unique ID

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the memory item to delete

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword or text phrase to search for
